title: A looting routine that gets the valuables out
target: How to work a level so the loot reaches the extraction point instead of being lost on the way there.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Room to carry at least one object

steps.do: Take the small valuables first and leave the awkward ones for a second trip.
steps.because: valuables are individual objects of very different size (GumballValuable, ValuableEgg, BlenderValuable, TrafficLightValuable)

steps.do: Clear the path to extraction before you carry the biggest item.
steps.because: the level defines which valuables it places, so what you find is not random scenery (LevelValuables)

steps.do: Pick up the boxed valuables when you have a free hand.
steps.because: at least one valuable comes in a box you can carry (ItemValuableBox)

commonMistakes: Grabbing the heaviest object first and running out of time to place it.
Clearing the level before completing any extraction.
Walking past a boxed valuable because it does not look like loot.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
